Name: Melbourne Subcortex Atlas
Description: A hierarchical MRI atlas of the human subcortex. The atlas is available in four scales (S1-S4), representing different levels of granularity. Scale 1 is the coarsest (16 regions) and Scale 4 is the finest (54 regions). The atlas delineates subdivisions of the striatum, thalamus, hippocampus, amygdala and globus pallidus based on functional connectivity gradients.
